how_to_apply: Code point = glyph id of the embedded subset; the map is per font FAMILY (rawdict span['font'].split(',')[0]: Calibri / Cambria / TimesNewRoman / Arial). 'map' is the Calibri family (Calibri, Calibri,Bold, Calibri,Italic, Calibri,BoldItalic share one glyph order). Read glyphs with rawdict or texttrace: get_text('words') drops every code point below U+0020, which deletes Calibri A B C D E and Times digits. A U+0020 inside these spans is a gap MuPDF synthesised, not a glyph.
